notes.title: Arcade Tournament mode!
notes.notes: Some new updates and fixed based on your feedback. Including the new [u][b]Arcade Tournament[/b][/u] mode! Face off head to head against other ducks!

notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Several cosmetic bugs have been fixed based on your feedback. Thank you for reaching out to me, a silhouette of the duck is now visible through the walls as the walls climb higher.

Hope you are all having fun, and thank you for all your support <3

You can give me feedback anytime on my website www.devokestudio.com
